pages.title: A three-card tarot spread for a better question
pages.intro: Let the first card name the real tension, the second widen your view, and the third suggest a small action.
pages.questionLabel: What question deserves a clearer shape today?
pages.questionPlaceholder: Example: What do I need to understand before changing direction at work?
pages.journalPrompt: Rewrite your question as one sentence beginning with ‘What would help me…?’
pages.resultCopy: Use the spread as a conversation with yourself: notice what feels specific, then test one small step.
pages.metaDescription: A free three-card tarot spread that helps you clarify a complicated question and find one grounded next step.

pages.title: A gentle tarot spread for relationship questions
pages.intro: Explore the need, pattern, and honest conversation underneath a question about love.
pages.questionLabel: What would you like to understand about this relationship?
pages.questionPlaceholder: Example: How can I ask for what I need without abandoning myself?
pages.journalPrompt: Write one boundary or request you can express without blame.
pages.resultCopy: Clarity grows when a symbolic insight becomes a respectful question you can actually ask.
pages.metaDescription: Reflect on relationship questions with a free three-card love tarot spread focused on needs, patterns, and communication.

pages.title: Yes or no tarot for a focused question
pages.intro: Draw one card for a symbolic direction, then add the context only you can know.
pages.questionLabel: What decision needs a clear, compassionate pause?
pages.questionPlaceholder: Example: Is this the right week to start the conversation?
pages.journalPrompt: List one fact, one feeling, and one condition that would change your answer.
pages.resultCopy: A yes-or-no symbol can begin reflection; your values and real-world information complete the decision.
pages.metaDescription: Ask one focused question and receive a symbolic yes-or-no tarot reflection with a practical context prompt.

pages.title: Your daily clarity tarot card
pages.intro: Choose one card, then turn its image into a question you can carry through the day.
pages.questionLabel: What part of today would benefit from attention?
pages.questionPlaceholder: Optional: name a moment you want to meet with more clarity.
pages.journalPrompt: Finish this sentence: ‘Today I can make space for…’
pages.resultCopy: Let the card become a lens, not a forecast. Return to the useful question when the day gets noisy.
pages.metaDescription: Draw a free daily tarot card and turn its symbolic theme into a practical question for today.
